quote: The upregulation of solute carrier genes (slc) was also shown in fish in relation to salinity-related stress (78).
statement: 溶质载体基因（slc）的上调也与鱼类面临的盐度相关应激有关。
text_zh: 溶质载体基因（slc）的上调也与鱼类面临的盐度相关应激有关。
text_en: The upregulation of solute carrier genes (slc) is also associated with salinity-related stress faced by fish.

quote: The upregulation of ccr7 , ccr9 , cxcr3B and cxcr4 was previously shown in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) after infection by VHSV (100).
statement: 此前已证明，虹鳟感染VHSV后，ccr7、ccr9、cxcr3B和cxcr4基因表达上调。
text_zh: 此前已证明，虹鳟感染VHSV后，ccr7、ccr9、cxcr3B和cxcr4基因表达上调。
text_en: It has previously been shown that the expression of ccr7, ccr9, cxcr3B and cxcr4 genes is upregulated in rainbow trout after VHSV infection.
outcome: 病毒感染后的基因表达

quote: Fish were euthanized by physical stunning through a blow to the skull with a blunt wooden instrument immediately followed by exsanguination.
statement: 鱼类通过用钝木器击打头部进行物理致晕，随后立即放血以实施安乐死。
text_zh: 鱼类通过用钝木器击打头部进行物理致晕，随后立即放血以实施安乐死。
text_en: Fish are physically stunned by striking the head with a blunt wooden instrument, followed immediately by exsanguination to implement euthanasia.

quote: In previous studies, we found that Bacillus sp. strain QSI-1 was able to inhibit A. hydrophila virulence in vitro and in vivo [ 20 ].
statement: 先前的研究发现，芽孢杆菌QSI-1菌株能够在体外和体内抑制嗜水气单胞菌的毒力。
text_zh: 先前的研究发现，芽孢杆菌QSI-1菌株能够在体外和体内抑制嗜水气单胞菌的毒力。
text_en: Previous studies have found that Bacillus sp. strain QSI-1 can inhibit the virulence of Aeromonas hydrophila in vitro and in vivo.

quote: The larvae were reared in aquaria with oxygenated water for 35 days, then the temperature gradually decreased to 22 °C.
statement: 幼虫在充氧水的鱼缸中饲养35天，随后温度逐渐降至22°C。
text_zh: 幼虫在充氧水的鱼缸中饲养35天，随后温度逐渐降至22°C。
text_en: Larvae were reared in oxygenated water in aquaria for 35 days, after which the temperature was gradually reduced to 22°C.
intervention: Oxygenated water rearing with temperature regulation
intervention_record: 充氧水饲养及温度调控

quote: The larvae were fed with live artemia, subsequently frozen adult artemia and commercial dry pellet.
statement: 幼虫喂食活丰年虾，随后喂食冷冻成年丰年虾和商业干饲料。
text_zh: 幼虫喂食活丰年虾，随后喂食冷冻成年丰年虾和商业干饲料。
text_en: Larvae were fed live brine shrimp, followed by frozen adult brine shrimp and commercial dry feed.

quote: Previous studies have shown that Bacillus sp. strain QSI-1 can produce quorum quenching enzyme (AiiA QSI-1), has probiotic properties and also, can decrease the pathogenicity of A. hydrophila infection in zebrafish (Danio rerio) and Goldfish (Carassius auratus) models
statement: 先前的研究表明，芽孢杆菌QSI-1菌株能产生群体感应淬灭酶（AiiA QSI-1），具有益生菌特性，并能降低斑马鱼和金鱼模型中嗜水气单胞菌感染的致病性。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，芽孢杆菌QSI-1菌株能产生群体感应淬灭酶（AiiA QSI-1），具有益生菌特性，并能降低斑马鱼和金鱼模型中嗜水气单胞菌感染的致病性。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that Bacillus sp. strain QSI-1 produces a quorum sensing quenching enzyme (AiiA QSI-1), has probiotic properties, and reduces the pathogenicity of Aeromonas hydrophila infection in zebrafish and goldfish models.

quote: In this study, we show that the QQ enzyme, obtained via heterologous expression of AiiA QSI-1 in Escherichia coli , is able to quench AHLs, reduce the expression of several virulence factors of A. hydrophila , and can also increase the survival rate of the Crucian Carp against experimental A. hydrophila infection.
statement: 本研究表明，通过在大肠杆菌中异源表达获得的AiiA QSI-1群体感应淬灭酶能够淬灭AHLs，降低嗜水气单胞菌几种毒力因子的表达，并提高鲫鱼在实验性嗜水气单胞菌感染中的存活率。
text_zh: 本研究表明，通过在大肠杆菌中异源表达获得的AiiA QSI-1群体感应淬灭酶能够淬灭AHLs，降低嗜水气单胞菌几种毒力因子的表达，并提高鲫鱼在实验性嗜水气单胞菌感染中的存活率。
text_en: This study shows that the AiiA QSI-1 quorum sensing quenching enzyme, obtained through heterologous expression in Escherichia coli, can quench AHLs, reduce the expression of several virulence factors of Aeromonas hydrophila, and improve the survival rate of crucian carp in experimental Aeromonas hydrophila infection.
outcome: 存活率; 毒力因子表达

quote: The A. hydrophila hexanoyl homoserine lactone (C6-HSL) QS signal molecule was degraded by AiiA QSI-1 , which resulted in a decrease of bacterial swimming motility, reduction of extracellular protease and hemolysin virulence factors, and inhibited the biofilm formation of A. hydrophila YJ-1 in a microtiter assay.
statement: AiiA QSI-1通过降解C6-HSL信号分子，导致细菌游动性降低、胞外蛋白酶和溶血素毒力因子减少，并抑制了生物膜的形成。
text_zh: AiiA QSI-1通过降解C6-HSL信号分子，导致细菌游动性降低、胞外蛋白酶和溶血素毒力因子减少，并抑制了生物膜的形成。
text_en: AiiA QSI-1, by degrading C6-HSL signal molecules, led to reduced bacterial motility, decreased extracellular protease and hemolysin virulence factors, and inhibited biofilm formation.

quote: In cell culture studies, AiiA QSI-1 decreased the ability of A. hydrophila adherence to and internalization by Epithelioma papulosum cyprini (EPC) cells.
statement: 在细胞培养研究中，AiiA QSI-1降低了嗜水气单胞菌对鲤鱼上皮瘤（EPC）细胞的粘附和内化能力。
text_zh: 在细胞培养研究中，AiiA QSI-1降低了嗜水气单胞菌对鲤鱼上皮瘤（EPC）细胞的粘附和内化能力。
text_en: In cell culture studies, AiiA QSI-1 reduced the adhesion and internalization of Aeromonas hydrophila to epithelioma papulosum cyprini (EPC) cells.

population.species: 鲤鱼上皮瘤细胞 (Epithelioma papulosum cyprini)

quote: During in vivo studies, oral administration of AiiA QSI-1 via feed supplementation attenuated A. hydrophila infection in Crucian Carp .
statement: 在体内研究中，通过饲料补充口服给予AiiA QSI-1减轻了鲫鱼中嗜水气单胞菌的感染。
text_zh: 在体内研究中，通过饲料补充口服给予AiiA QSI-1减轻了鲫鱼中嗜水气单胞菌的感染。
text_en: In in vivo studies, oral administration of AiiA QSI-1 via feed supplementation reduced Aeromonas hydrophila infection in crucian carp.

quote: Li et al. 31 showed that male incidence in laboratory gynogenetic C. gibelio progenies increased with increasing larval rearing temperature.
statement: Li等人研究表明，随着幼鱼培育温度的升高，实验室单性生殖银鲫后代中的雄性发生率增加。
text_zh: Li等人研究表明，随着幼鱼培育温度的升高，实验室单性生殖银鲫后代中的雄性发生率增加。
text_en: Li et al. showed that as the rearing temperature of juvenile fish increases, the male occurrence rate in offspring of laboratory gynogenetic silver crucian carp increases.

quote: Given the apparent lack of toxicity of QQ-supplemented feed on Crucian carp survival (Figure 6), we conclude that QQ-containing feed supplements should be explored for commercial use in aquaculture.
statement: 鉴于QQ补充饲料对鲫鱼存活率无明显毒性，作者得出结论认为含QQ的饲料补充剂应被探索用于水产养殖的商业用途。
text_zh: 鉴于QQ补充饲料对鲫鱼存活率无明显毒性，作者得出结论认为含QQ的饲料补充剂应被探索用于水产养殖的商业用途。
text_en: Given that QQ feed supplements showed no significant toxicity to crucian carp survival rates, the authors concluded that QQ-containing feed supplements should be explored for commercial use in aquaculture.

quote: Signal disruption referred to as quorum quenching (QQ) has been described in several biological systems and is being explored as a novel approach to fight human, plant, and animal infections.
statement: 被称为群体淬灭（QQ）的信号破坏已在多种生物系统中被描述，并正作为一种对抗人类、植物和动物感染的新方法进行研究。
text_zh: 被称为群体淬灭（QQ）的信号破坏已在多种生物系统中被描述，并正作为一种对抗人类、植物和动物感染的新方法进行研究。
text_en: Signal disruption known as quorum quenching (QQ) has been described in various biological systems and is being investigated as a new approach against human, plant, and animal infections.

quote: QQ is also being examined as a mechanism to combat aquaculture-related infections
statement: 群体淬灭（QQ）也被作为对抗水产养殖相关感染的机制进行研究。
text_zh: 群体淬灭（QQ）也被作为对抗水产养殖相关感染的机制进行研究。
text_en: Quorum quenching (QQ) has also been studied as a mechanism to combat aquaculture-related infections.

quote: The inhibition of AiiA QSI-1 on the biofilm formation by A. hydrophila YJ-1 was tested using crystal violet staining assay
statement: 使用结晶紫染色法测试了AiiA QSI-1对嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1生物膜形成的抑制作用。
text_zh: 使用结晶紫染色法测试了AiiA QSI-1对嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1生物膜形成的抑制作用。
text_en: The inhibitory effect of AiiA QSI-1 on biofilm formation by Aeromonas hydrophila YJ-1 was tested using the crystal violet staining method.

quote: AiiA QSI-1 protein exhibited inhibitory activity in both adherence and internalization of A. hydrophila YJ-1 to EPC cells
statement: AiiA QSI-1蛋白对嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1粘附和内化至EPC细胞表现出抑制活性。
text_zh: AiiA QSI-1蛋白对嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1粘附和内化至EPC细胞表现出抑制活性。
text_en: The AiiA QSI-1 protein exhibited inhibitory activity against the adhesion and internalization of Aeromonas hydrophila YJ-1 into EPC cells.

population.species: Crucian carp (implied via context of study, though EPC is cell line)

quote: No dead fish were observed in the AiiA QSI-1 and control groups, indicating that AiiA QSI-1 is not toxic for Crucian Carp .
statement: 在AiiA QSI-1组和对照组中未观察到死鱼，表明AiiA QSI-1对鲫鱼无毒。
text_zh: 在AiiA QSI-1组和对照组中未观察到死鱼，表明AiiA QSI-1对鲫鱼无毒。
text_en: No dead fish were observed in the AiiA QSI-1 group and the control group, indicating that AiiA QSI-1 is non-toxic to crucian carp.

quote: AiiA QSI-1 significantly attenuated the A. hydrophila YJ-1 infection.
statement: AiiA QSI-1显著减弱了嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1的感染。
text_zh: AiiA QSI-1显著减弱了嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1的感染。
text_en: AiiA QSI-1 significantly reduced the infection of Aeromonas hydrophila YJ-1.

quote: Compared with group A. hydrophila YJ-1, the survival percent of group feeding with AiiA QSI-1 was significantly higher than the commercial diet group infected with AhYJ-1, increased about 25.6% at day 4.
statement: 与仅喂食商业饲料并感染AhYJ-1的组相比，喂食AiiA QSI-1组的存活率显著更高，在第4天增加了约25.6%。
text_zh: 与仅喂食商业饲料并感染AhYJ-1的组相比，喂食AiiA QSI-1组的存活率显著更高，在第4天增加了约25.6%。
text_en: Compared to the group fed only commercial feed and infected with AhYJ-1, the survival rate of the AiiA QSI-1 fed group was significantly higher, increasing by about 25.6% on day 4.

quote: The oral administration of AiiA QSI-1 supplement in feed significantly attenuated Aeromonas hydrophila YJ-1 infection in carp.
statement: 在饲料中口服给予AiiA QSI-1补充剂显著减轻了鲤鱼的嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1感染。
text_zh: 在饲料中口服给予AiiA QSI-1补充剂显著减轻了鲤鱼的嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1感染。
text_en: Oral administration of AiiA QSI-1 supplement in feed significantly reduced Aeromonas hydrophila YJ-1 infection in common carp.

quote: Our results indicate that the AiiA QSI-1 represents a promising candidate to use in pilot-scale tests as a feed-based therapeutic agent for aquaculture and provides a viable alternative to antibiotics against Aeromonas diseases in aquaculture.
statement: 结果表明，AiiA QSI-1作为水产养殖中基于饲料的治疗剂是一个有希望的候选者，并为对抗水产养殖中的气单胞菌病提供了抗生素的可行替代品。
text_zh: 结果表明，AiiA QSI-1作为水产养殖中基于饲料的治疗剂是一个有希望的候选者，并为对抗水产养殖中的气单胞菌病提供了抗生素的可行替代品。
text_en: The results indicate that AiiA QSI-1 as a feed-based therapeutic agent in aquaculture is a promising candidate and provides a feasible alternative to antibiotics for combating aeromonad disease in aquaculture.

quote: Our results shown that oral administration of AiiA QSI-1 via feed supplementation can significantly attenuate A. hydrophila infection in Crucian Carp .
statement: 本研究结果显示，通过饲料补充口服给予AiiA QSI-1可显著减轻鲫鱼的气单胞菌感染。
text_zh: 本研究结果显示，通过饲料补充口服给予AiiA QSI-1可显著减轻鲫鱼的气单胞菌感染。
text_en: The results of this study show that oral administration of AiiA QSI-1 via feed supplementation significantly reduced Aeromonas infection in crucian carp.

quote: The AHL-lactonase AiiAB546 from Bacillus sp. B546 was expressed extracellularly in Pichia pastoris , and could decrease the mortality rate in common carp when it was co-injected with A. hydrophila [ 27 ].
statement: 来自芽孢杆菌B546的AHL内酯酶AiiAB546在毕赤酵母中胞外表达，当与气单胞菌共同注射时，可降低鲤鱼的死亡率。
text_zh: 来自芽孢杆菌B546的AHL内酯酶AiiAB546在毕赤酵母中胞外表达，当与气单胞菌共同注射时，可降低鲤鱼的死亡率。
text_en: The AHL lactonase AiiAB546 from Bacillus sp. B546, expressed extracellularly in Pichia pastoris, reduced mortality in carp when co-injected with Aeromonas.

quote: AiiAAI96, from Bacillus sp. AI96 significantly attenuated A. hydrophila infection in zebra fish when administered orally as feed supplementation [ 28 ].
statement: 来自芽孢杆菌AI96的AiiAAI96作为饲料补充剂口服给药时，可显著减轻斑马鱼的气单胞菌感染。
text_zh: 来自芽孢杆菌AI96的AiiAAI96作为饲料补充剂口服给药时，可显著减轻斑马鱼的气单胞菌感染。
text_en: Oral administration of AiiAAI96 from Bacillus AI96 as a feed supplement significantly reduced Aeromonas infection in zebrafish.

quote: Liu et al. reported that, lactonase AIO6 supplemented to tilapia was able to prevent the A. hydrophila infection [ 29 ].
statement: Liu等人报道，给罗非鱼补充内酯酶AIO6能够预防气单胞菌感染。
text_zh: Liu等人报道，给罗非鱼补充内酯酶AIO6能够预防气单胞菌感染。
text_en: Liu et al. reported that supplementing tilapia with lactonase AIO6 could prevent Aeromonas infection.

quote: Our findings suggest that differences in gut bacterial community composition may be an important factor contributing to the rapid growth and high disease resistance of the new fish lineages.
statement: 研究结果表明，肠道细菌群落组成的差异可能是导致新鱼类品系快速生长和高抗病性的重要因素。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，肠道细菌群落组成的差异可能是导致新鱼类品系快速生长和高抗病性的重要因素。
text_en: The results of the study indicate that differences in gut bacterial community composition may be an important factor contributing to the rapid growth and high disease resistance of new fish strains.

population.species: new fish lineages (implied crucian carp/grass carp from keywords)

quote: Experimental fish were euthanized by overdose of tricaine methane sulfonate (MS222; 50 mg/L) and were aseptically dissected to obtain midgut samples and their contents
statement: 实验鱼通过过量三卡因甲磺酸酯（MS222；50 mg/L）安乐死，并进行无菌解剖以获取中肠样本及其内容物。
text_zh: 实验鱼通过过量三卡因甲磺酸酯（MS222；50 mg/L）安乐死，并进行无菌解剖以获取中肠样本及其内容物。
text_en: Experimental fish were euthanized by overdose of tricaine methanesulfonate (MS222; 50 mg/L) and dissected aseptically to obtain midgut samples and their contents.

quote: The dead fishes presented hemorrhagic septicemia symptoms, and bacteria isolated from dead fishes’ organs (liver, spleen, and kidney) and ascites were identified as A. hydrophila by selective medium and biochemical tests as described by Palumbo et al. [ 26 ].
statement: 死鱼表现出出血性败血症症状，从死鱼器官（肝、脾、肾）和腹水中分离出的细菌经选择性培养基和生化测试鉴定为嗜水气单胞菌。
text_zh: 死鱼表现出出血性败血症症状，从死鱼器官（肝、脾、肾）和腹水中分离出的细菌经选择性培养基和生化测试鉴定为嗜水气单胞菌。
text_en: Dead fish exhibited symptoms of hemorrhagic septicemia; bacteria isolated from the organs (liver, spleen, kidney) and ascites fluid of dead fish were identified as Aeromonas hydrophila through selective media and biochemical tests.

quote: Thus, the QQ demonstrated by AiiA QSI-1 (this study) and other QQ agents [ 21 , 22 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] has the added potential benefit of reducing antibiotic resistance in A. hydrophila biofilms as well as reducing A. hydrophila virulence.
statement: 因此，本研究及他人展示的群体感应淬灭（QQ）具有减少嗜水气单胞菌生物膜抗生素耐药性以及降低其毒力的潜在额外益处。
text_zh: 因此，本研究及他人展示的群体感应淬灭（QQ）具有减少嗜水气单胞菌生物膜抗生素耐药性以及降低其毒力的潜在额外益处。
text_en: Therefore, the quorum sensing quenching (QQ) demonstrated in this study and by others has potential additional benefits of reducing antibiotic resistance in Aeromonas hydrophila biofilms and lowering its virulence.

quote: Secondly, longer term studies would enable a thorough assessment of any potential toxic side-effects of QQ treatments on fish.
statement: 其次，更长期的研究将能够彻底评估QQ处理对鱼的任何潜在毒性副作用。
text_zh: 其次，更长期的研究将能够彻底评估QQ处理对鱼的任何潜在毒性副作用。
text_en: Secondly, longer-term studies will be able to thoroughly assess any potential toxic side effects of QQ treatment on fish.

quote: A third benefit of a pilot-scale study would be to investigate whether there might be an onset of resistance to quorum-disrupting treatments.
statement: 中试规模研究的第三个好处是调查是否可能出现对群体感应破坏治疗的耐药性。
text_zh: 中试规模研究的第三个好处是调查是否可能出现对群体感应破坏治疗的耐药性。
text_en: The third benefit of the pilot-scale study is to investigate whether resistance to quorum sensing disruption therapy may occur.

quote: The reduction in virulence was not due to A. hydrophila YJ-1 planktonic culture growth inhibition as growth of this pathogen was slightly enhanced by the presence of AiiA QSI-1 (Figure 4 B).
statement: 毒力的降低并非由于对嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1浮游培养生长的抑制，因为该病原体的生长因AiiA QSI-1的存在而略有增强。
text_zh: 毒力的降低并非由于对嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1浮游培养生长的抑制，因为该病原体的生长因AiiA QSI-1的存在而略有增强。
text_en: The reduction in virulence was not due to the inhibition of planktonic growth of Aeromonas hydrophila YJ-1, because the growth of this pathogen was slightly enhanced by the presence of AiiA QSI-1.

quote: Wang et al. [ 21 ] demonstrated that AiiA S1-5 from Altererythrobacter sp. S1-5 showed the QQ efficacy against quorum sensing-mediated virulence traits of A. hydrophila and Vibrio alginolyticus , such as motility and biofilm formation.
statement: Wang等人证明来自Altererythrobacter sp. S1-5的AiiA S1-5对嗜水气单胞菌和溶藻弧菌的群体感应介导的毒力特征（如运动性和生物膜形成）表现出群体淬灭功效。
text_zh: Wang等人证明来自Altererythrobacter sp. S1-5的AiiA S1-5对嗜水气单胞菌和溶藻弧菌的群体感应介导的毒力特征（如运动性和生物膜形成）表现出群体淬灭功效。
text_en: Wang et al. demonstrated that AiiA S1-5 from Altererythrobacter sp. S1-5 exhibited quorum quenching efficacy against the quorum sensing-mediated virulence traits (such as motility and biofilm formation) of Aeromonas hydrophila and Vibrio alginolyticus.
outcome: 病原菌毒力因子（运动性、生物膜）

quote: Our results also showed AiiA QSI-1 can inhibit motility and biofilm formation in A. hydrophila.
statement: 本研究结果也显示AiiA QSI-1可以抑制嗜水气单胞菌的运动性和生物膜形成。
text_zh: 本研究结果也显示AiiA QSI-1可以抑制嗜水气单胞菌的运动性和生物膜形成。
text_en: The results of this study also show that AiiA QSI-1 can inhibit the motility and biofilm formation of Aeromonas hydrophila.
outcome: 病原菌运动性与生物膜形成

quote: Previous reports validate sterile hybrids, involved in Pure‐line grass carp and Xiangyun crucian carp, and have some advantages such as faster growth (~1.43 times) and higher anti‐disease ability (~1.5 times) (Chen et al., 2009 ; Liu et al., 2001 ; Xiao et al., 2019).
statement: 先前的报告证实，涉及纯系草鱼和湘云鲫的不育杂交种具有更快的生长速度（约1.43倍）和更高的抗病能力（约1.5倍）等优势。
text_zh: 先前的报告证实，涉及纯系草鱼和湘云鲫的不育杂交种具有更快的生长速度（约1.43倍）和更高的抗病能力（约1.5倍）等优势。
text_en: Previous reports confirmed that sterile hybrids involving pure-line grass carp and Xiangyun crucian carp have advantages such as faster growth (about 1.43 times) and higher disease resistance (about 1.5 times).

quote: The observed differences of gut microbiota between new lineages and indigenous may be an important influencing factor for different growth and disease resistance.
statement: 新谱系与本地品种之间肠道微生物群的差异可能是影响生长和抗病能力的重要因素。
text_zh: 新谱系与本地品种之间肠道微生物群的差异可能是影响生长和抗病能力的重要因素。
text_en: The differences in gut microbiota between the new lineage and local varieties may be an important factor affecting growth and disease resistance.

quote: We speculated that the intestinal bacterial community was more likely to change in new lineage fish and might be regulated by changing the feeding conditions, thereby promoting the growth of new lineage fish.
statement: 作者推测，通过改变饲养条件可能调节新谱系鱼类的肠道细菌群落，从而促进其生长。
text_zh: 作者推测，通过改变饲养条件可能调节新谱系鱼类的肠道细菌群落，从而促进其生长。
text_en: The authors speculate that changing rearing conditions may modulate the gut bacterial communities of new lineage fish, thereby promoting their growth.
outcome: 肠道菌群稳定性与生长性能

quote: significant differences were found in the microbial community composition of the new linages versus indigenous fish populations, suggesting the possibility that results in the advantages of enhanced disease resistance and rapid growth for the new fish lineages.
statement: 新品系与本地鱼类种群之间的微生物群落组成存在显著差异，暗示这可能是导致新鱼品系增强抗病力和快速生长优势的原因。
text_zh: 新品系与本地鱼类种群之间的微生物群落组成存在显著差异，暗示这可能是导致新鱼品系增强抗病力和快速生长优势的原因。
text_en: There are significant differences in microbial community composition between the new strain and local fish populations, suggesting that this may be the reason for the enhanced disease resistance and rapid growth advantage of the new fish strain.
outcome: 疾病抵抗力与生长速度

quote: Long‐term crowding stress causes compromised nonspecific immunity and increases apoptosis of spleen in grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella).
statement: 长期拥挤应激导致草鱼非特异性免疫力受损并增加脾脏细胞凋亡。
text_zh: 长期拥挤应激导致草鱼非特异性免疫力受损并增加脾脏细胞凋亡。
text_en: Long-term crowding stress impaired non-specific immunity and increased splenic cell apoptosis in grass carp.

quote: A web‐based combined nutritional model to precisely predict growth, feed requirement and waste output of gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio) in aquaculture operations.
statement: 一种基于网络的组合营养模型可精确预测养殖操作中银鲫的生长、饲料需求和废物输出。
text_zh: 一种基于网络的组合营养模型可精确预测养殖操作中银鲫的生长、饲料需求和废物输出。
text_en: A web-based combined nutrition model can accurately predict growth, feed requirements, and waste output of silver crucian carp in aquaculture operations.
outcome: 生长性能与代谢废物管理

quote: Prior to experimentation, 600 fishes were acclimatized in 12 aquariums (100 L) for 10 days, at a temperature of 25 ± 1.0 °C, dissolved oxygen >5 mg/L, and given commercial feed twice each day at 08:30 and 17:30.
statement: 实验前，600条鱼在12个水族箱（100升）中驯养10天，温度为25±1.0°C，溶解氧大于5毫克/升，并于每天08:30和17:30投喂商业饲料两次。
text_zh: 实验前，600条鱼在12个水族箱（100升）中驯养10天，温度为25±1.0°C，溶解氧大于5毫克/升，并于每天08:30和17:30投喂商业饲料两次。
text_en: Before the experiment, 600 fish were acclimated for 10 days in 12 aquaria (100 liters), at a temperature of 25±1.0°C, with dissolved oxygen greater than 5 mg/L, and fed commercial feed twice daily at 08:30 and 17:30.

quote: The commercial feed was supplied by Huaian Tongwei Co. Ltd., Huaian, China, and contained 47% fishmeal, 24% soybean meal, 24% wheat flour, 2% soybean oil, 3% premix, and no antibiotics (42.0% crude protein and 7.29% crude lipid).
statement: 使用的商业饲料由淮安通威有限公司提供，不含抗生素，粗蛋白含量42.0%，粗脂肪含量7.29%。
text_zh: 使用的商业饲料由淮安通威有限公司提供，不含抗生素，粗蛋白含量42.0%，粗脂肪含量7.29%。
text_en: The commercial feed used was provided by Huai'an Tongwei Co., Ltd., contained no antibiotics, had a crude protein content of 42.0%, and a crude fat content of 7.29%.

quote: For 50% lethal dose (LD50) determinations, seven groups of 10 Crucian carps were intraperitoneally injected with 0.02 mL of serially tenfold diluted bacterial suspensions containing 10 1 –10 8 CFU.
statement: 通过腹腔注射不同浓度的细菌悬液测定半数致死量（LD50）。
text_zh: 通过腹腔注射不同浓度的细菌悬液测定半数致死量（LD50）。
text_en: The median lethal dose (LD50) was determined by intraperitoneal injection of bacterial suspensions at different concentrations.

quote: The fish were monitored at 25 ± 1.0 °C for mortality for 7 days. During this period, activity and behavior of fish were recorded daily, and LD 50 were calculated by the method of Reed and Muench [ 43 ].
statement: 在25±1.0°C条件下监测鱼群7天的死亡率，并记录日常活动行为以计算LD50。
text_zh: 在25±1.0°C条件下监测鱼群7天的死亡率，并记录日常活动行为以计算LD50。
text_en: Fish mortality was monitored for 7 days at 25±1.0°C, and daily activity behavior was recorded to calculate LD50.

quote: For the preparation of AiiA QSI-1 containing diets, the AiiA QSI-1 protein was suspended in saline solution and mixed with basal diet at final concentration 0.5g AiiA QSI-1 per kilogram.
statement: 制备含AiiA QSI-1蛋白的饲料时，将蛋白悬浮于生理盐水中并与基础日粮混合，最终浓度为每千克0.5克。
text_zh: 制备含AiiA QSI-1蛋白的饲料时，将蛋白悬浮于生理盐水中并与基础日粮混合，最终浓度为每千克0.5克。
text_en: When preparing feed containing AiiA QSI-1 protein, the protein was suspended in physiological saline and mixed with the basal diet, resulting in a final concentration of 0.5 grams per kilogram.

quote: groups B and D were fed with the commercial diet supplemented with AiiA QSI-1 protein.
statement: B组和D组饲喂添加了AiiA QSI-1蛋白的商业饲料。
text_zh: B组和D组饲喂添加了AiiA QSI-1蛋白的商业饲料。
text_en: Groups B and D were fed commercial feed supplemented with AiiA QSI-1 protein.

quote: After 10 days of feeding the fishes, groups C and D were intraperitoneally injected with 200 μL of A. hydrophila YJ-1 suspension containing 6.0 × 10 6 cells (5 × LD 50), and groups A and B were administered 200 μL sterile physiological saline.
statement: 饲喂10天后，C组和D组腹腔注射嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1悬液（5倍LD50），A组和B组注射无菌生理盐水作为对照。
text_zh: 饲喂10天后，C组和D组腹腔注射嗜水气单胞菌YJ-1悬液（5倍LD50），A组和B组注射无菌生理盐水作为对照。
text_en: After 10 days of feeding, groups C and D were intraperitoneally injected with Aeromonas hydrophila YJ-1 suspension (5 times LD50), while groups A and B were injected with sterile saline as controls.

quote: The fish survival was recorded every day during the 4-days of experimental period, and dead fishes were removed for bacteriological inspection [ 27 ].
statement: 在4天实验期内每天记录鱼的存活情况，并对死鱼进行细菌学检查。
text_zh: 在4天实验期内每天记录鱼的存活情况，并对死鱼进行细菌学检查。
text_en: During the 4-day experimental period, fish survival was recorded daily, and dead fish underwent bacteriological examination.
intervention_record: 存活率记录与病理检查

quote: In addition, several nodes were negatively correlated with other nodes on the network, such as Aeromonas , Cetobacterium , norank_f_Erysipelotrichaceae, Shewanella , Bacillus , and Bacteroides , in which the patterns were caused by favorable genera for fish's survival outcompeting with less favorable ones.
statement: 网络中某些节点与其他节点呈负相关，这种模式是由有利于鱼类生存的属与不太有利的属之间的竞争造成的。
text_zh: 网络中某些节点与其他节点呈负相关，这种模式是由有利于鱼类生存的属与不太有利的属之间的竞争造成的。
text_en: Some nodes in the network are negatively correlated with other nodes; this pattern is caused by competition between genera favorable to fish survival and less favorable genera.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成与生存能力

quote: Effect of AiiA QSI-1 on the Protection Against Aeromonas Hydrophila Infection
statement: 研究考察了AiiA QSI-1对抵抗嗜水气单胞菌感染的保护作用。
text_zh: 研究考察了AiiA QSI-1对抵抗嗜水气单胞菌感染的保护作用。
text_en: The study examined the protective effect of AiiA QSI-1 against Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: Furthermore, through analyses of immune parameters, leukocyte phagocytic activity, detection of bacterial load in visceral tissues, evaluation of antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, assessment of histopathology and cell degeneration and apoptosis of visceral tissues (Figure 1), the immunomodulatory function of the MCR-WE was evaluated, with the aim of developing a novel agent for the prevention and control of aquaculture pathogens.
statement: 通过分析免疫参数、白细胞吞噬活性、内脏组织细菌载量检测、抗氧化和抗炎活性评估以及内脏组织病理学和细胞变性凋亡评估，评价了MCR-WE的免疫调节功能，旨在开发一种用于水产养殖病原体预防和控制的新制剂。
text_zh: 通过分析免疫参数、白细胞吞噬活性、内脏组织细菌载量检测、抗氧化和抗炎活性评估以及内脏组织病理学和细胞变性凋亡评估，评价了MCR-WE的免疫调节功能，旨在开发一种用于水产养殖病原体预防和控制的新制剂。
text_en: The immunomodulatory function of MCR-WE was evaluated by analyzing immune parameters, leukocyte phagocytic activity, bacterial load in visceral tissues, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, and histopathology and cellular degeneration/apoptosis in visceral tissues, aiming to develop a new formulation for the prevention and control of pathogens in aquaculture.

quote: Fish gut microbiota could promote the development of the immune system or directly activate the innate immune pathway to improve their anti‐disease ability.
statement: 鱼类肠道微生物群可以促进免疫系统的发育或直接激活先天免疫途径以提高其抗病能力。
text_zh: 鱼类肠道微生物群可以促进免疫系统的发育或直接激活先天免疫途径以提高其抗病能力。
text_en: Fish gut microbiota can promote the development of the immune system or directly activate innate immune pathways to improve their disease resistance.

quote: After being fed once daily for 10 consecutive days, the fish were challenged by intraperitoneal injection with 40 μL of A. veronii (1.5 × 10 9 CFU) based on preliminary experiments.
statement: 连续喂食10天后，通过腹腔注射维氏气单胞菌对鱼进行攻毒试验。
text_zh: 连续喂食10天后，通过腹腔注射维氏气单胞菌对鱼进行攻毒试验。
text_en: After 10 consecutive days of feeding, fish were challenged by intraperitoneal injection with Aeromonas veronii.

quote: Mortality of the crucian carp was observed for 14 days.
statement: 观察鲫鱼的死亡率持续14天。
text_zh: 观察鲫鱼的死亡率持续14天。
text_en: The mortality rate of crucian carp was observed for 14 days.

quote: After 10 days of continuous administration, the fish were challenged with A. veronii (1 × 10 9 CFU).
statement: 连续给药10天后，用维氏气单胞菌（1×10^9 CFU）对鱼进行攻击感染。
text_zh: 连续给药10天后，用维氏气单胞菌（1×10^9 CFU）对鱼进行攻击感染。
text_en: After 10 consecutive days of administration, fish were challenged with Aeromonas veronii (1×10^9 CFU).

quote: After 10 days of continuous administration, the fish were challenged with 40 μL of A. veronii (1 × 10 9 CFU).
statement: 连续给药10天后，鱼被维氏气单胞菌攻击。
text_zh: 连续给药10天后，鱼被维氏气单胞菌攻击。
text_en: After 10 days of continuous administration, the fish were challenged with Aeromonas veronii.

quote: The number of bacterial colonies on the medium was counted, and the colony count was used to evaluate the clearance effect of MCR-WE against A. veronii in crucian carp
statement: 通过计数菌落数来评估MCR-WE对鲫鱼体内维氏气单胞菌的清除效果。
text_zh: 通过计数菌落数来评估MCR-WE对鲫鱼体内维氏气单胞菌的清除效果。
text_en: The clearance effect of MCR-WE on Aeromonas veronii in crucian carp was evaluated by counting colony numbers.

quote: by feeding the MCR-WE to crucian carp (Carassius auratus) and challenging them with Aeromonas veronii , it was found that the MCR-WE enhanced the activities of immune factors (AKP, ACP, LZM) and the phagocytic activity of leukocytes
statement: 饲喂桑白皮水提物（MCR-WE）并攻毒维氏气单胞菌后，发现MCR-WE增强了免疫因子（AKP、ACP、LZM）的活性和白细胞的吞噬活性。
text_zh: 饲喂桑白皮水提物（MCR-WE）并攻毒维氏气单胞菌后，发现MCR-WE增强了免疫因子（AKP、ACP、LZM）的活性和白细胞的吞噬活性。
text_en: After feeding with mulberry root bark water extract (MCR-WE) and challenging with Aeromonas veronii, it was found that MCR-WE enhanced the activity of immune factors (AKP, ACP, LZM) and the phagocytic activity of leukocytes.

quote: its application in the prevention and control of aquatic pathogens remains understudied
statement: 桑白皮在水生病原体防控中的应用研究仍然不足。
text_zh: 桑白皮在水生病原体防控中的应用研究仍然不足。
text_en: Research on the application of mulberry root bark in the prevention and control of aquatic pathogens is still insufficient.

quote: Studies have found that fish immunized with inactivated or attenuated strains of A. veronii confers good immune protective activity [ 17 , 18 , 19 ].
statement: 研究发现，用灭活或减毒的A. veronii菌株免疫鱼类可赋予良好的免疫保护活性。
text_zh: 研究发现，用灭活或减毒的A. veronii菌株免疫鱼类可赋予良好的免疫保护活性。
text_en: The study found that immunizing fish with inactivated or attenuated A. veronii strains can confer good immune protection activity.

quote: However, there is a lack of vaccines targeting A. veronii in the market.
statement: 然而，市场上缺乏针对A. veronii的疫苗。
text_zh: 然而，市场上缺乏针对A. veronii的疫苗。
text_en: However, there is a lack of vaccines against A. veronii on the market.

quote: Traditional Chinese medicinal herbs offer advantages such as being green, leaving low residues, and not easily inducing drug resistance in the prevention and control of Aeromonas infections.
statement: 中草药在预防和控制气单胞菌感染方面具有绿色、低残留且不易诱导耐药性的优势。
text_zh: 中草药在预防和控制气单胞菌感染方面具有绿色、低残留且不易诱导耐药性的优势。
text_en: Chinese herbal medicine has the advantages of being green, having low residue, and not easily inducing drug resistance in the prevention and control of Aeromonas infection.

quote: Kenanoğlu et al. found that dietary supplementation with extracts of Urtica dioica and Phillyrea latifolia contributed to a survival rate of 96% in Sparus aurata following challenge with Vibrio anguillarum [ 22 ].
statement: Kenanoğlu等人发现，日粮中添加荨麻和宽叶女贞提取物有助于金头鲷在鳗弧菌攻击后达到96%的存活率。
text_zh: Kenanoğlu等人发现，日粮中添加荨麻和宽叶女贞提取物有助于金头鲷在鳗弧菌攻击后达到96%的存活率。
text_en: Kenanoğlu et al. found that dietary supplementation with nettle and privet leaf extracts helped sea bream achieve a 96% survival rate after Vibrio anguillarum challenge.

quote: Nasmia et al. demonstrated that palm waste extract exhibited antibacterial activity against major fish pathogens, including Vibrio harveyi and Vibrio parahaemolyticus [ 24 ].
statement: Nasmia等人证明，棕榈废弃物提取物对包括哈维氏弧菌和副溶血性弧菌在内的主要鱼类病原体表现出抗菌活性。
text_zh: Nasmia等人证明，棕榈废弃物提取物对包括哈维氏弧菌和副溶血性弧菌在内的主要鱼类病原体表现出抗菌活性。
text_en: Nasmia et al. demonstrated that palm waste extract exhibited antibacterial activity against major fish pathogens, including Vibrio harveyi and Vibrio parahaemolyticus.

quote: However, research on the application of MCR for the prevention and control of aquatic pathogens in aquaculture remains insufficient.
statement: 关于MCR在水产养殖中防治水生病原体的应用研究仍然不足。
text_zh: 关于MCR在水产养殖中防治水生病原体的应用研究仍然不足。
text_en: Research on the application of MCR in controlling aquatic pathogens in aquaculture remains insufficient.

quote: With the development of intensive aquaculture technologies, pathogen infections inevitably occur, causing huge economic losses to the aquaculture industry [ 7 , 8 ].
statement: 随着集约化养殖技术的发展，病原体感染不可避免地发生，给水产养殖业造成巨大的经济损失。
text_zh: 随着集约化养殖技术的发展，病原体感染不可避免地发生，给水产养殖业造成巨大的经济损失。
text_en: With the development of intensive aquaculture technology, pathogen infections inevitably occur, causing huge economic losses to the aquaculture industry.
counterevidence: 导致病原体感染和经济损失

quote: In the control group, all fish died within 5 days, while mortality in the MCR-WE group stabilized after 5 days (Figure 4).
statement: 在对照组中，所有鱼在5天内死亡，而MCR-WE组的死亡率在5天后趋于稳定。
text_zh: 在对照组中，所有鱼在5天内死亡，而MCR-WE组的死亡率在5天后趋于稳定。
text_en: In the control group, all fish died within 5 days, while the mortality rate in the MCR-WE group stabilized after 5 days.

quote: The immune protection rate of MCR-WE was 40% (p Table 5).
statement: MCR-WE的免疫保护率为40%。
text_zh: MCR-WE的免疫保护率为40%。
text_en: The immune protection rate of MCR-WE is 40%.

quote: Compared with the control group, the bacterial count in the kidneys of crucian carp was significantly reduced in the MCR-WE group (p Figure 5).
statement: 与对照组相比，MCR-WE组鲫鱼肾脏中的细菌计数显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，MCR-WE组鲫鱼肾脏中的细菌计数显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, bacterial counts in the kidneys of crucian carp in the MCR-WE group were significantly reduced.

quote: Compared with the control group, the levels of antioxidant-related factors (CAT, GSH-PX, SOD, and MDA) were significantly decreased (p Figure 6).
statement: 与对照组相比，抗氧化相关因子（CAT、GSH-PX、SOD和MDA）的水平显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，抗氧化相关因子（CAT、GSH-PX、SOD和MDA）的水平显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the levels of antioxidant-related factors (CAT, GSH-PX, SOD and MDA) were significantly decreased.

quote: The results showed that the mRNA expression levels of key factors (Nrf2, HO-1, Keap1) related to antioxidant pathway were significantly decreased (p Figure 7).
statement: 饲喂MCR-WE后，受维氏气单胞菌攻毒的鲫鱼肾脏和脾脏中与抗氧化通路相关的关键因子（Nrf2、HO-1、Keap1）mRNA表达水平显著降低。
text_zh: 饲喂MCR-WE后，受维氏气单胞菌攻毒的鲫鱼肾脏和脾脏中与抗氧化通路相关的关键因子（Nrf2、HO-1、Keap1）mRNA表达水平显著降低。
text_en: After feeding MCR-WE, the mRNA expression levels of key factors related to the antioxidant pathway (Nrf2, HO-1, Keap1) in the kidney and spleen of crucian carp challenged with Aeromonas veronii were significantly decreased.

quote: These findings indicate that the level of antioxidative stress was reduced in crucian carp, suggesting that MCR-WE possesses antioxidant properties.
statement: 研究结果表明鲫鱼的抗氧化应激水平降低，提示MCR-WE具有抗氧化特性。
text_zh: 研究结果表明鲫鱼的抗氧化应激水平降低，提示MCR-WE具有抗氧化特性。
text_en: The results showed that the antioxidant stress level of crucian carp decreased, suggesting that MCR-WE has antioxidant properties.

quote: The results indicated that the mRNA expression levels of most inflammatory factors exhibited a decreasing trend (p Figure 8).
statement: 结果显示大多数炎症因子（IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β）的mRNA表达水平呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 结果显示大多数炎症因子（IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β）的mRNA表达水平呈下降趋势。
text_en: The results showed that the mRNA expression levels of most inflammatory factors (IL-6, TNF-α and IL-1β) tended to decrease.

quote: These findings suggest that MCR-WE can reduce the inflammatory response in crucian carp during A. veronii infection, demonstrating that MCR-WE possesses anti-inflammatory effects.
statement: 这些发现表明MCR-WE可以减轻维氏气单胞菌感染期间鲫鱼的炎症反应，证明MCR-WE具有抗炎作用。

quote: Total attacks per trial (chases plus nips) as estimated from the different species level interactions (Table 1) showed that goldfish received more attacks under polyculture con-ditions in both batches, compared to koi carp.
statement: 在两个批次的混养条件下，金鱼受到的总攻击次数多于锦鲤。
text_zh: 在两个批次的混养条件下，金鱼受到的总攻击次数多于锦鲤。
text_en: Under mixed-culture conditions in two batches, goldfish received more total attacks than koi.

quote: Under monoculture conditions, the incidence of attacks in gold-fish tanks were lower compared to koi carp tanks, marking the koi carp as a more aggressive species.
statement: 在单养条件下，金鱼缸中的攻击发生率低于锦鲤缸，表明锦鲤是更具攻击性的物种。
text_zh: 在单养条件下，金鱼缸中的攻击发生率低于锦鲤缸，表明锦鲤是更具攻击性的物种。
text_en: Under monoculture conditions, the incidence of aggression in goldfish tanks was lower than in koi carp tanks, indicating that koi carp are a more aggressive species.

quote: In India, ornamental fish ponds are generally much smaller, compared to other aqua-culture ponds, and competition pressure may severely affect the production status of the “non aggressive” species under such confined habitat conditions.
statement: 印度观赏鱼池塘通常比其他水产养殖池塘小得多，在这种受限的栖息地条件下，竞争压力可能会严重影响“非攻击性”物种的生产状况。
text_zh: 印度观赏鱼池塘通常比其他水产养殖池塘小得多，在这种受限的栖息地条件下，竞争压力可能会严重影响“非攻击性”物种的生产状况。
text_en: Indian ornamental fish ponds are usually much smaller than other aquaculture ponds; under such restricted habitat conditions, competition pressure may seriously affect the production status of "non-aggressive" species.

quote: the data are clearly indicative of behavioural interactions between the species concerned
statement: 数据清楚地表明相关物种之间存在行为相互作用。
text_zh: 数据清楚地表明相关物种之间存在行为相互作用。
text_en: The data clearly indicate behavioral interactions among the relevant species.

quote: further studies are encouraged to increase precision of observations (e.g. by video-recording and electronic image analysis systems)
statement: 鼓励进一步研究以提高观察的精确度（例如通过视频录制和电子图像分析系统）。
text_zh: 鼓励进一步研究以提高观察的精确度（例如通过视频录制和电子图像分析系统）。
text_en: Further research is encouraged to improve the precision of observations (for example, through video recording and electronic image analysis systems).

quote: Further research is also required to investigate how dynamic behavioural interac- tions are affected by variation in abundance ratios as well as food availability and temperature, i.e. factors that play significant roles in tropical pond conditions.
statement: 还需要进一步研究以调查丰度比、食物可用性和温度等变化如何影响动态行为相互作用，这些因素在热带池塘条件下起着重要作用。
text_zh: 还需要进一步研究以调查丰度比、食物可用性和温度等变化如何影响动态行为相互作用，这些因素在热带池塘条件下起着重要作用。
text_en: Further research is needed to investigate how changes in dynamic behavioral interactions, such as abundance ratios, food availability and temperature, which play an important role under tropical pond conditions, affect them.
intervention: Variation in abundance ratio, food and temperature
intervention_record: 丰度比、食物和温度变化
outcome: 环境因子对行为的影响

quote: nt and significant immunostimulatory effects without observable adverse effects on fish behavior, feed intake, or growth.
statement: The treatment showed significant immunostimulatory effects with no observable adverse effects on fish behavior, feed intake, or growth.
text_en: The treatment showed significant immunostimulatory effects with no observable adverse effects on fish behavior, feed intake, or growth.

quote: Studies on similar plant extract immunostimulants (e.g., Astragalus polysaccharides , Agaricus bisporus) indicate that 7–14 days of pre-treatment is required to achieve significant elevation of serum immune factor activities [ 24 , 37 ].
statement: Previous studies indicate that 7–14 days of pre-treatment with similar plant extract immunostimulants are required to significantly elevate serum immune factor activities.
text_en: Previous studies indicate that 7–14 days of pre-treatment with similar plant extract immunostimulants are required to significantly elevate serum immune factor activities.

quote: Its flavonoid compounds (morusin) inhibit the release of inflammatory cytokines, thereby reducing tissue damage; simultaneously, they scavenge free radicals, alleviate oxidative stress, and protect immune cell function [ 38 ].
statement: Flavonoid compounds like morusin inhibit inflammatory cytokine release to reduce tissue damage, while scavenging free radicals to alleviate oxidative stress and protect immune cell function.
text_en: Flavonoid compounds like morusin inhibit inflammatory cytokine release to reduce tissue damage, while scavenging free radicals to alleviate oxidative stress and protect immune cell function.
outcome: 组织损伤、氧化应激和免疫功能

quote: Xiao et al. found that after immunizing fish with the protein, DNA, and IgY antibody vaccines of Vibrio fluvialis VF08100 protein and subsequently challenging them with different pathogenic bacteria, the expression of antioxidant-related factors (MDA, GSH-Px, CAT, SOD) and inflammatory cytokine mRNAs (IL-6, IL-8, IL-1β, TNF-α) was reduced, thereby decreasing oxidative stress and inflammatory responses [ 28 ].
statement: Immunization with specific vaccines followed by bacterial challenge reduced the expression of antioxidant factors and inflammatory cytokines, thereby decreasing oxidative stress and inflammatory responses.
text_en: Immunization with specific vaccines followed by bacterial challenge reduced the expression of antioxidant factors and inflammatory cytokines, thereby decreasing oxidative stress and inflammatory responses.

quote: The impact of aggressive behaviour of koi carp was clearly demonstrated by the increased level of attack on goldfish in the polyculture treatments in both the experimental batches.
statement: 在两个实验批次的混养处理中，对金鱼攻击水平的增加清楚地证明了锦鲤攻击性行为的影响。
text_zh: 在两个实验批次的混养处理中，对金鱼攻击水平的增加清楚地证明了锦鲤攻击性行为的影响。
text_en: In the mixed-culture treatments of two experimental batches, the increase in aggression levels of goldfish clearly demonstrated the effect of koi carp aggressive behavior.

population.system: 实验批次（水族箱/池塘模拟）

quote: In the first batch, live tubifex were applied in feeding baskets and placed on the floor of the tanks.
statement: 在第一批次中，活的水丝蚓被放入喂食篮并置于水箱底部。
text_zh: 在第一批次中，活的水丝蚓被放入喂食篮并置于水箱底部。
text_en: In the first batch, live Tubifex worms were placed in feeding baskets and positioned at the bottom of the tank.

quote: For the second batch, the food (plankton) was added centrally onto the water surface and the live plankton dispersed rapidly over the entire water surface.
statement: 在第二批次中，食物（浮游生物）被集中添加到水面，活浮游生物迅速分散到整个水面。
text_zh: 在第二批次中，食物（浮游生物）被集中添加到水面，活浮游生物迅速分散到整个水面。
text_en: In the second batch, food (plankton) was concentratedly added to the water surface, and live plankton quickly dispersed across the entire water surface.

quote: This way of offering the food generally increases feeding opportunity and promotes uniformity of feeding and growth (McCarthy et al. 1999, Gomez-Laplaza 2002).
statement: 这种提供食物的方式通常能增加摄食机会并促进摄食和生长的均匀性。
text_zh: 这种提供食物的方式通常能增加摄食机会并促进摄食和生长的均匀性。
text_en: This method of providing feed usually increases feeding opportunities and promotes uniformity in feeding and growth.

quote: Thus, this experiment mainly explored the effects of different levels of coated methionine in high plant protein diets on the growth performance, serum biochemistry, liver antioxidant, intestinal digestive enzymes and expression of genes related to TOR pathway, and the optimum addition amount of coated methionine was determined by the growth parameter of gibel carp, which provided some reference for practical production.
statement: 本实验主要探讨了高植物蛋白日粮中不同水平包膜蛋氨酸对生长性能、血清生化指标、肝脏抗氧化能力、肠道消化酶及TOR通路相关基因表达的影响，并通过异育银鲫的生长参数确定包膜蛋氨酸的最佳添加量。
text_zh: 本实验主要探讨了高植物蛋白日粮中不同水平包膜蛋氨酸对生长性能、血清生化指标、肝脏抗氧化能力、肠道消化酶及TOR通路相关基因表达的影响，并通过异育银鲫的生长参数确定包膜蛋氨酸的最佳添加量。
text_en: This experiment mainly investigated the effects of different levels of encapsulated methionine in high plant protein diets on growth performance, serum biochemical indicators, liver antioxidant capacity, intestinal digestive enzymes, and TOR pathway-related gene expression, and determined the optimal supplementation level of encapsulated methionine through the growth parameters of gibel carp.

quote: At the end of the feeding trial, 6 gibel carp were chosen at random from each tank and anesthetized using MS-222 (at a concentration of 400 mg/L).
statement: 在饲养试验结束时，从每个水箱中随机选取6条鲫鱼并使用MS-222（浓度400 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在饲养试验结束时，从每个水箱中随机选取6条鲫鱼并使用MS-222（浓度400 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_en: At the end of the feeding trial, 6 crucian carp were randomly selected from each tank and anesthetized using MS-222 (concentration 400 mg/L).
outcome: 采样过程中的动物处理与应激控制

quote: Blood was attained via the tail vein and centrifuged (3500 r/min, 10 min) at 4°C to obtain plasma serum, which was stored in a refrigerator at -80°C.
statement: 通过尾静脉采血，并在4°C下离心（3500转/分，10分钟）以获取血浆血清，随后储存在-80°C冰箱中。
text_zh: 通过尾静脉采血，并在4°C下离心（3500转/分，10分钟）以获取血浆血清，随后储存在-80°C冰箱中。
text_en: Blood was collected via the tail vein, and plasma/serum was obtained by centrifugation at 4°C (3500 rpm, 10 minutes), then stored in a -80°C freezer.
outcome: 非致死性血液采样方法

quote: The fish were maintained in aer-ated and filtered aquaria, under artificial lights (12 L : 12 D photoperiod).
statement: 鱼类被饲养在充气和过滤的水族箱中，并在人工光照（12小时光照：12小时黑暗的光周期）下管理。
text_zh: 鱼类被饲养在充气和过滤的水族箱中，并在人工光照（12小时光照：12小时黑暗的光周期）下管理。
text_en: Fish were kept in aerated and filtered aquariums and managed under artificial lighting (a photoperiod of 12 hours light: 12 hours dark).
intervention: Aerated filtered aquarium with artificial photoperiod
intervention_record: 充气过滤水族箱与人工光周期

quote: The tanks were filled with tap water (water volume 150 L; 20 fish/tank).
statement: 水箱注满自来水，水量为150升，每箱放养20条鱼。
text_zh: 水箱注满自来水，水量为150升，每箱放养20条鱼。
text_en: The tanks were filled with tap water to a volume of 150 liters, and 20 fish were stocked per tank.
intervention_record: 自来水养殖与特定密度

quote: The fish were fed live tubifex worm (first batch) and live zooplankton (second batch) dur-ing this period, offered daily in the amount of 5% body weight of the fish stocked (the actual amount of food was adjusted every weekly).
statement: 在此期间，第一批鱼投喂活水丝蚓，第二批鱼投喂活浮游动物，每日投喂量为存塘鱼体重的5%，且每周调整实际投喂量。
text_zh: 在此期间，第一批鱼投喂活水丝蚓，第二批鱼投喂活浮游动物，每日投喂量为存塘鱼体重的5%，且每周调整实际投喂量。
text_en: During this period, the first batch of fish was fed live tubifex worms, and the second batch of fish was fed live zooplankton. The daily feeding amount was 5% of the body weight of the fish in the pond, and the actual feeding amount was adjusted weekly.

quote: This study explored the impacts of supplementation of different levels of coated methionine (Met) in a high-plant protein diet on growth, blood biochemistry, antioxidant capacity, digestive enzymes activity and expression of genes related to TOR signaling pathway in gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibeilo).
statement: 本研究探讨了在高植物蛋白日粮中添加不同水平的包被蛋氨酸对银鲫生长、血液生化、抗氧化能力、消化酶活性及TOR信号通路相关基因表达的影响。
text_zh: 本研究探讨了在高植物蛋白日粮中添加不同水平的包被蛋氨酸对银鲫生长、血液生化、抗氧化能力、消化酶活性及TOR信号通路相关基因表达的影响。
text_en: This study investigated the effects of adding different levels of encapsulated methionine to a high plant protein diet on the growth, blood biochemistry, antioxidant capacity, digestive enzyme activity, and expression of TOR signaling pathway-related genes in silver crucian carp.
outcome: 生长性能、血液生化指标、抗氧化能力、消化酶活性

quote: In these trials, monoculture or polyculture groups totalling 20 fish were used in each aquarium.
statement: 试验中每个水族箱使用了总计20条鱼的单养或多养组。
text_zh: 试验中每个水族箱使用了总计20条鱼的单养或多养组。
text_en: In the experiment, each aquarium used a total of 20 fish in monoculture or polyculture groups.

quote: The treatments (for each batch) were: (1) koi carp, monoculture; (2) goldfish, monoculture; and (3) koi carp and goldfish, polyculture, stocked at 1:1.
statement: 处理组包括：(1) 锦鲤单养；(2) 金鱼单养；以及 (3) 按1:1比例放养的锦鲤和金鱼多养。
text_zh: 处理组包括：(1) 锦鲤单养；(2) 金鱼单养；以及 (3) 按1:1比例放养的锦鲤和金鱼多养。
text_en: The treatment groups included: (1) koi monoculture; (2) goldfish monoculture; and (3) polyculture of koi and goldfish stocked at a 1:1 ratio.

quote: Grid markings on the tanks allowed the location (depth) of the fish in the water col- umn to be estimated.
statement: 水箱上的网格标记允许估计鱼在水柱中的位置（深度）。
text_zh: 水箱上的网格标记允许估计鱼在水柱中的位置（深度）。
text_en: Grid markings on the tank allow estimation of fish position (depth) in the water column.

quote: The tanks were screened with black art paper from four sides and an eye slit was cut on the front side, which allowed the experimenter to observe and record the behaviour of fish without disturbing them.
statement: 水箱四周用黑色艺术纸遮挡，正面开有观察缝，使实验者能在不干扰鱼的情况下观察并记录其行为。
text_zh: 水箱四周用黑色艺术纸遮挡，正面开有观察缝，使实验者能在不干扰鱼的情况下观察并记录其行为。
text_en: The four sides of the tank are covered with black art paper, with an observation slit on the front, allowing experimenters to observe and record fish behavior without disturbing them.

quote: In each trial, the fish were placed in the tank and left to set- tle for 1 h.
statement: 在每次试验中，将鱼放入水箱并静置1小时。
text_zh: 在每次试验中，将鱼放入水箱并静置1小时。
text_en: In each trial, the fish were placed in a tank and left to settle for 1 hour.

quote: This was followed by a period of focal sam- pling (Martin and Bateson 1990) for 5 minutes in which the occurrence and direction of all antagonistic interac- tions (chases, nips) involving a randomly chosen individ- ual of each species were recorded.
statement: 随后进行5分钟的焦点取样，记录涉及每种随机选择个体的所有对抗性互动（追逐、咬啄）的发生和方向。
text_zh: 随后进行5分钟的焦点取样，记录涉及每种随机选择个体的所有对抗性互动（追逐、咬啄）的发生和方向。
text_en: Subsequently, a 5-minute focal sampling was conducted, recording the occurrence and direction of all agonistic interactions (chasing, pecking) involving each randomly selected individual.

quote: Fish polyculture is attempted by stocking two or more species with different feeding habits and different habitat preferences (Lutz 2003).
statement: 鱼类混养是通过放养具有不同摄食习性和不同栖息地偏好的两个或多个物种来实现的。
text_zh: 鱼类混养是通过放养具有不同摄食习性和不同栖息地偏好的两个或多个物种来实现的。
text_en: Polyculture of fish is achieved by stocking two or more species with different feeding habits and different habitat preferences.

quote: The productivity of the aquatic system is thus increased by introducing more than one compatible fish species in a culture system, where the growth and survival of one species is not negatively affected by the other.
statement: 通过在养殖系统中引入一种以上相容的鱼类，且一个物种的生长和存活不受另一个物种负面影响，从而提高了水生系统的生产力。
text_zh: 通过在养殖系统中引入一种以上相容的鱼类，且一个物种的生长和存活不受另一个物种负面影响，从而提高了水生系统的生产力。
text_en: Productivity of aquatic systems is increased by introducing more than one compatible fish species into the farming system, where the growth and survival of one species are not negatively affected by another.

quote: Experiments were conducted to document behavioural responses of koi carp, Cyprinus carpio L., and goldfish, Carassius auratus (L.) to monoculture and polyculture conditions in aquaria.
statement: 实验旨在记录锦鲤和金鱼在单养和多养条件下的行为反应。
text_zh: 实验旨在记录锦鲤和金鱼在单养和多养条件下的行为反应。
text_en: The experiment aimed to record the behavioral responses of koi and goldfish under monoculture and polyculture conditions.

quote: Two parallel experiments, otherwise involving similar experimental protocols, were carried out with two batches of fish, fed with live tubifex worm (first batch) and live zooplankton (second batch).
statement: 进行了两个平行实验，分别使用活水蚯蚓和活浮游动物喂养两批鱼。
text_zh: 进行了两个平行实验，分别使用活水蚯蚓和活浮游动物喂养两批鱼。
text_en: Two parallel experiments were conducted, feeding two batches of fish with live tubifex worms and live zooplankton, respectively.

quote: Each of the trials, randomized with respect to treatment, yielded data on aggressive encounters (chases, nips), both in presence and absence of food.
statement: 每个试验均随机分配处理，并记录了有食物和无食物情况下的攻击性遭遇数据（追逐、咬）。
text_zh: 每个试验均随机分配处理，并记录了有食物和无食物情况下的攻击性遭遇数据（追逐、咬）。
text_en: Each trial randomly assigned treatments, and aggressive encounter data (chasing, biting) were recorded in the presence and absence of food.

quote: Frequency of attack increased in the presence of food.
statement: 在有食物的情况下，攻击频率增加。
text_zh: 在有食物的情况下，攻击频率增加。
text_en: In the presence of food, aggression frequency increased.

quote: The impact of aggressive behaviour of koi carp was conspicuous by the increased level of attack on goldfish in polyculture trials in both experimental batches.
statement: 锦鲤的攻击性行为的影响显而易见，表现为在多养试验中两组实验批次中对金鱼的攻击水平均有所增加。
text_zh: 锦鲤的攻击性行为的影响显而易见，表现为在多养试验中两组实验批次中对金鱼的攻击水平均有所增加。
text_en: The impact of koi aggression was evident, as aggression levels towards goldfish increased in both experimental batches in the polyculture trial.

quote: The physico-chemical conditions were similar in all the holding tanks (temperature 24–26°C; pH 7.0–7.2; dissolved oxygen content 6.5-6.8 mg · L–1).
statement: 所有暂养缸中的理化条件相似（温度24–26°C；pH 7.0–7.2；溶解氧含量6.5-6.8 mg·L–1）。
text_zh: 所有暂养缸中的理化条件相似（温度24–26°C；pH 7.0–7.2；溶解氧含量6.5-6.8 mg·L–1）。
text_en: The physicochemical conditions in all holding tanks were similar (temperature 24–26°C; pH 7.0–7.2; dissolved oxygen content 6.5-6.8 mg·L–1).

quote: Quadratic regression analysis showed that the WG was the highest at 0.71% Met level.
statement: 二次回归分析显示，体重增长（WG）在0.71%的蛋氨酸水平时达到最高。
text_zh: 二次回归分析显示，体重增长（WG）在0.71%的蛋氨酸水平时达到最高。
text_en: Quadratic regression analysis showed that weight gain (WG) reached its maximum at a methionine level of 0.71%.

quote: Serum ALT activity decreased significantly with increasing levels of coated Met, reaching its lowest level in the 1.06% dietary treatment
statement: 随着包被蛋氨酸水平的增加，血清ALT活性显著降低，并在1.06%日粮处理组中达到最低水平。
text_zh: 随着包被蛋氨酸水平的增加，血清ALT活性显著降低，并在1.06%日粮处理组中达到最低水平。
text_en: As the level of encapsulated methionine increased, serum ALT activity decreased significantly and reached its lowest level in the 1.06% diet treatment group.
outcome: 肝脏健康指标（血清生化参数）

quote: However, AST activity showed a linearly decrease by polynomial analysis
statement: 多项式分析显示AST活性呈线性下降趋势。
text_zh: 多项式分析显示AST活性呈线性下降趋势。
text_en: Polynomial analysis showed a linear decreasing trend in AST activity.
outcome: 肝脏健康指标（血清生化参数）

quote: Hepatopancreas MDA content (Table 6) generally decreased and then slightly increased with the level of coated Met, reaching the lowest level in the 0.92% dietary treatment
statement: 肝胰腺MDA含量随包被蛋氨酸水平增加先普遍下降后轻微上升，在0.92%日粮处理组中达到最低水平。
text_zh: 肝胰腺MDA含量随包被蛋氨酸水平增加先普遍下降后轻微上升，在0.92%日粮处理组中达到最低水平。
text_en: Hepatopancreas MDA content generally decreased and then slightly increased with increasing levels of encapsulated methionine, reaching the lowest level in the 0.92% dietary treatment group.

quote: However, plant proteins come with challenges such as high crude fiber content, higher anti-nutritional properties, and imbalanced amino acid composition (4).
statement: 植物蛋白饲料存在粗纤维含量高、抗营养特性高以及氨基酸组成不平衡等挑战。
text_zh: 植物蛋白饲料存在粗纤维含量高、抗营养特性高以及氨基酸组成不平衡等挑战。
text_en: Plant protein feed faces challenges such as high crude fiber content, high anti-nutritional properties, and unbalanced amino acid composition.

quote: High plant protein feed often results in a lack of essential amino acids (6).
statement: 高比例植物蛋白饲料通常导致必需氨基酸缺乏。
text_zh: 高比例植物蛋白饲料通常导致必需氨基酸缺乏。
text_en: High-proportion plant protein feed usually leads to essential amino acid deficiency.

quote: However, a lack of dietary methionine can result in growth retardation (8), reduce feed efficiency (9), and affect body metabolism (10) and intestinal health development (11).
statement: 日粮中缺乏蛋氨酸会导致生长迟缓、降低饲料效率，并影响机体代谢和肠道健康发育。
text_zh: 日粮中缺乏蛋氨酸会导致生长迟缓、降低饲料效率，并影响机体代谢和肠道健康发育。
text_en: Methionine deficiency in the diet leads to growth retardation, reduced feed efficiency, and affects body metabolism and intestinal health development.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料效率、代谢及肠道健康

quote: Prior to the feeding trial, all the fish were acclimatized for 2 weeks
statement: 在饲养试验前，所有鱼均进行了为期2周的驯化。
text_zh: 在饲养试验前，所有鱼均进行了为期2周的驯化。
text_en: Before the feeding trial, all fish underwent a 2-week acclimation period.

quote: The experimental recirculating system was housed outdoors and the fish were fed manually twice a day (8:30 am and 17:30 pm) at 2.5% to 3% of body weight.
statement: 实验循环水系统置于室外，鱼类每天手动投喂两次（上午8:30和下午17:30），投喂量为体重的2.5%至3%。
text_zh: 实验循环水系统置于室外，鱼类每天手动投喂两次（上午8:30和下午17:30），投喂量为体重的2.5%至3%。

quote: Additionally, feed residues were collected from the culture system 30 min after feeding.
statement: 此外，在投喂后30分钟从养殖系统中收集残饵。
text_zh: 此外，在投喂后30分钟从养殖系统中收集残饵。
text_en: In addition, leftover feed was collected from the aquaculture system 30 minutes after feeding.

quote: During the feeding trial, the water conditions were consistently within the specified ranges, with the water temperature ranging from 20°C to 32°C, dissolved oxygen levels maintained at or above 6.0 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen levels kept below 0.3 mg/L, and nitrite levels maintained below 0.05 mg/L.
statement: 在饲养试验期间，水质条件始终保持在指定范围内：水温20°C至32°C，溶解氧维持在6.0 mg/L或以上，氨氮低于0.3 mg/L，亚硝酸盐低于0.05 mg/L。
text_zh: 在饲养试验期间，水质条件始终保持在指定范围内：水温20°C至32°C，溶解氧维持在6.0 mg/L或以上，氨氮低于0.3 mg/L，亚硝酸盐低于0.05 mg/L。
text_en: During the feeding trial, water quality conditions were consistently maintained within the specified ranges: water temperature 20°C to 32°C, dissolved oxygen at 6.0 mg/L or above, ammonia nitrogen below 0.3 mg/L, and nitrite below 0.05 mg/L.

quote: At the conclusion of 10-week feeding trial, the SR of gibel carp was 100% (Table 3).
statement: 在为期10周的饲养试验结束时，鲫鱼的存活率为100%。
text_zh: 在为期10周的饲养试验结束时，鲫鱼的存活率为100%。
text_en: At the end of a 10-week feeding trial, the survival rate of crucian carp was 100%.

quote: Goldfish in mono-culture treatments appeared less aggressive, compared to monocultured koi carp in both experimental batches.
statement: 在单养处理中，金鱼表现出比单养锦鲤更低的攻击性。
text_zh: 在单养处理中，金鱼表现出比单养锦鲤更低的攻击性。
text_en: In the monoculture treatment, goldfish exhibited lower aggression than koi in monoculture.

quote: Even in the polyculture treatments, goldfish attacked con-specifics or other species (koi carp) very rarely.
statement: 即使在混养处理中，金鱼也极少攻击同种个体或其他物种（锦鲤）。
text_zh: 即使在混养处理中，金鱼也极少攻击同种个体或其他物种（锦鲤）。
text_en: Even in polyculture treatments, goldfish rarely attacked individuals of the same species or other species (koi).

quote: On the other hand, koi carp were overwhelmingly more aggres-sive.
statement: 另一方面，锦鲤表现出压倒性的更高攻击性。
text_zh: 另一方面，锦鲤表现出压倒性的更高攻击性。
text_en: On the other hand, koi showed overwhelmingly higher aggression.

quote: The frequency of attack increased significantly in the presence of food.
statement: 在有食物存在的情况下，攻击频率显著增加。
text_zh: 在有食物存在的情况下，攻击频率显著增加。
text_en: In the presence of food, aggression frequency increased significantly.

quote: Food was shown to increase the rates of aggression in gouramis, Trichogaster trichopterus (Pallas) (Syarifuddin and Kramer 1996) and poeciliids, Gambusia holbrooki (Girard) and Xiphophorus helleri Heckel (Warburton and Madden 2003).
statement: 已有研究表明食物会增加曼龙鱼和花鳉科鱼类的攻击率。
text_zh: 已有研究表明食物会增加曼龙鱼和花鳉科鱼类的攻击率。
text_en: Existing studies have shown that feeding increases the aggression rate of gourami and poeciliid fish.

population.species: 曼龙鱼; 食蚊鱼; 剑尾鱼

quote: Newman (1956) postulated that the presence of food increased feeding activity, which in turn increased aggres-sive activity as the focus of attacks was displaced from the food to fellow fish of both species.
statement: Newman (1956) 推测食物的存在增加了摄食活动，进而因攻击焦点从食物转移到同类或异类鱼身上而增加了攻击活动。
text_zh: Newman (1956) 推测食物的存在增加了摄食活动，进而因攻击焦点从食物转移到同类或异类鱼身上而增加了攻击活动。
text_en: Newman (1956) speculated that the presence of food increased feeding activity, which in turn increased aggressive activity as the focus of aggression shifted from food to conspecific or heterospecific fish.

quote: He further noted that feeding fish displayed some movements that are associated with aggression, such as body undulations, swift darting and biting, and suggested that such movements constituted sign stimuli eliciting attacks from other species.
statement: 他进一步指出，正在摄食的鱼会展示一些与攻击相关的动作（如身体波动、快速冲刺和咬），并认为这些动作构成了引发其他物种攻击的信号刺激。
text_zh: 他进一步指出，正在摄食的鱼会展示一些与攻击相关的动作（如身体波动、快速冲刺和咬），并认为这些动作构成了引发其他物种攻击的信号刺激。
text_en: He further pointed out that fish in the process of feeding display some actions related to aggression (such as body undulations, rapid dashes, and biting), and considered these actions to constitute signal stimuli that trigger aggression in other species.

quote: The significantly higher rate of attacks in the polycul-ture treatments compared to monoculture conditions for both batches of fish undermines the very logic behind stocking koi carp and goldfish together.
statement: 两批鱼在混养处理中的攻击率均显著高于单养条件，这削弱了将锦鲤和金鱼一起放养的逻辑基础。
text_zh: 两批鱼在混养处理中的攻击率均显著高于单养条件，这削弱了将锦鲤和金鱼一起放养的逻辑基础。
text_en: The aggression rate in both batches of fish was significantly higher under the polyculture treatment than under monoculture conditions, which weakens the logical basis for stocking koi and goldfish together.

quote: Although the impact of nipping on the rate of spinal and caudal abnormalities or fin deformities were not estimated in the Jha et al. 134 present experiment, it could be suggested that sustained attacks, particularly on goldfish by
statement: 虽然本实验未评估啃咬对脊柱和尾部异常或鳍畸形发生率的影响，但可以推测持续的攻击（特别是针对金鱼的攻击）可能产生负面影响。
text_zh: 虽然本实验未评估啃咬对脊柱和尾部异常或鳍畸形发生率的影响，但可以推测持续的攻击（特别是针对金鱼的攻击）可能产生负面影响。
text_en: Although this experiment did not assess the effect of biting on the incidence of spinal and tail abnormalities or fin deformities, it can be inferred that continuous aggression (particularly against goldfish) may have negative effects.
limitations: 未在本实验中量化评估

quote: Previous studies on gibel carp (30) and Jian carp (Cyprinus carpiovar. Jian) (45) have found that the deficiency or excess of Met in feed can lead to an increase in serum transaminase activity, which negatively affects liver function in fish.
statement: 先前关于鲫鱼和建鲤的研究发现，饲料中蛋氨酸缺乏或过量会导致血清转氨酶活性升高，从而对鱼类肝功能产生负面影响。
text_zh: 先前关于鲫鱼和建鲤的研究发现，饲料中蛋氨酸缺乏或过量会导致血清转氨酶活性升高，从而对鱼类肝功能产生负面影响。
text_en: Previous studies on crucian carp and Jian carp found that methionine deficiency or excess in the diet leads to increased serum transaminase activity, thereby negatively affecting fish liver function.

quote: Serum biochemical assays were conducted for aspartate aminotransferase (AST, Cat. No. C010-1-1) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT, Cat. No. C009-1-1).
statement: 血清生化检测包括天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）。
text_zh: 血清生化检测包括天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）。
text_en: Serum biochemical tests include aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT).

quote: Additionally, antioxidant enzyme activities, including catalase (CAT, Cat. No. A007-1-1), superoxide dismutase (SOD, Cat. No. A001-1), and lipid peroxidation marker malondialdehyde (MDA, Cat. No. A003-1), were measured in the hepatopancreas.
statement: 在肝胰腺中测量了抗氧化酶活性（过氧化氢酶CAT、超氧化物歧化酶SOD）以及脂质过氧化标志物丙二醛（MDA）。
text_zh: 在肝胰腺中测量了抗氧化酶活性（过氧化氢酶CAT、超氧化物歧化酶SOD）以及脂质过氧化标志物丙二醛（MDA）。
text_en: Antioxidant enzyme activities (catalase CAT, superoxide dismutase SOD) and the lipid peroxidation marker malondialdehyde (MDA) were measured in the hepatopancreas.
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: Crystalline methionine is commonly used as a feed additive but its utilization varies across different fish species (21).
statement: 结晶蛋氨酸常用作饲料添加剂，但其利用率因不同鱼类而异。
text_zh: 结晶蛋氨酸常用作饲料添加剂，但其利用率因不同鱼类而异。
text_en: Crystalline methionine is commonly used as a feed additive, but its utilization rate varies among different fish species.

quote: As a result, the addition of crystal amino acids to gastritis fish, such as crucian carp (Carassius auratus gibelio) (23) and mirror carp (Cyprinus carpio) (24), rendering them ineffective.
statement: 因此，向胃炎鱼类（如鲫鱼和镜鲤）添加结晶氨基酸使其无效。
text_zh: 因此，向胃炎鱼类（如鲫鱼和镜鲤）添加结晶氨基酸使其无效。
text_en: Therefore, adding crystalline amino acids to fish with gastritis (such as crucian carp and mirror carp) rendered them ineffective.
outcome: 疾病状态下的营养效果

quote: Nevertheless, coating amino acids as opposed to crystalline methionine, has been shown to improve the utilization of amino acids by fish (25).
statement: 然而，与结晶蛋氨酸相比，包被氨基酸已被证明能改善鱼类对氨基酸的利用。
text_zh: 然而，与结晶蛋氨酸相比，包被氨基酸已被证明能改善鱼类对氨基酸的利用。
text_en: However, compared to crystalline methionine, coated amino acids have been shown to improve fish utilization of amino acids.

quote: The excessive Met in the feed also leads to a decrease in the WG of yellow catfish (Pelteobagrus fulvidraco) (38).
statement: 饲料中过量的蛋氨酸也会导致黄颡鱼增重下降。
text_zh: 饲料中过量的蛋氨酸也会导致黄颡鱼增重下降。
text_en: Excess methionine in feed also leads to reduced weight gain in yellow catfish.

quote: During the 70-day feeding period, the WG results for the fish ranged from 106.61% to 115.88%. The results showed normal growth, aligning with findings from other reports.
statement: 在70天的饲养期间，鱼的增重率范围为106.61%至115.88%，结果显示生长正常。
text_zh: 在70天的饲养期间，鱼的增重率范围为106.61%至115.88%，结果显示生长正常。
text_en: During the 70-day rearing period, the weight gain rate of fish ranged from 106.61% to 115.88%, indicating normal growth.

quote: Stress response and changes in amino acid requirements in Senegalese sole (Solea Senegalensis Kaup 1858).
statement: 塞内加尔鳎的应激反应伴随氨基酸需求的变化。
text_zh: 塞内加尔鳎的应激反应伴随氨基酸需求的变化。
text_en: The stress response of Senegalese sole is accompanied by changes in amino acid requirements.

quote: Effect of dietary protein on the nitrogen excretion and growth of the African catfish, Clarias gariepinus .
statement: 膳食蛋白质影响非洲鲶鱼的氮排泄和生长。
text_zh: 膳食蛋白质影响非洲鲶鱼的氮排泄和生长。
text_en: Dietary protein affects nitrogen excretion and growth in African catfish.

quote: Methionine hydroxy analogue prevents oxidative damage and improves antioxidant status of intestine and hepatopancreas for juvenile Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var. Jian).
statement: 羟基蛋氨酸类似物能预防建鲤幼鱼肠道和肝胰腺的氧化损伤并改善其抗氧化状态。
text_zh: 羟基蛋氨酸类似物能预防建鲤幼鱼肠道和肝胰腺的氧化损伤并改善其抗氧化状态。
text_en: Hydroxy methionine analogs can prevent oxidative damage in the intestine and hepatopancreas of juvenile Jian carp and improve their antioxidant status.

population.species: juvenile Jian carp (Cyprinus carpio var. Jian)

outcome: 氧化损伤与抗氧化状态

quote: Previous studies on grass carp reveal that adequate dietary Met level can notably elevate the intestinal digestive enzyme activity (11).
statement: 先前的草鱼研究表明，充足的日粮蛋氨酸水平可以显著提高肠道消化酶活性。
text_zh: 先前的草鱼研究表明，充足的日粮蛋氨酸水平可以显著提高肠道消化酶活性。
text_en: Previous studies on grass carp have shown that adequate dietary methionine levels can significantly improve intestinal digestive enzyme activity.

quote: Studies have shown that Met deficiency may result in decreased activity of digestion enzymes, and that dietary supplementation with coated Met may markedly increase intestinal digestion enzyme activity.
statement: 研究表明，蛋氨酸缺乏可能导致消化酶活性降低，而补充包被蛋氨酸可能显著增加肠道消化酶活性。
text_zh: 研究表明，蛋氨酸缺乏可能导致消化酶活性降低，而补充包被蛋氨酸可能显著增加肠道消化酶活性。
text_en: Studies indicate that methionine deficiency may lead to reduced digestive enzyme activity, while supplementation with encapsulated methionine may significantly increase intestinal digestive enzyme activity.

quote: This was confirmed in another study of mirror carp, and the addition of Met promoted intestinal villus height and muscle thickness, which had a positive effect on intestinal development (34).
statement: 在另一项镜鲤研究中证实，添加蛋氨酸促进了肠绒毛高度和肌肉厚度，对肠道发育有积极影响。
text_zh: 在另一项镜鲤研究中证实，添加蛋氨酸促进了肠绒毛高度和肌肉厚度，对肠道发育有积极影响。
text_en: Another study on mirror carp confirmed that methionine supplementation promoted intestinal villus height and muscle thickness, having a positive effect on gut development.

quote: glycinin and β-conglycinin induced damage in the intestine of mirror carp (Cyprinus carpio).
statement: 大豆球蛋白和β-伴大豆球蛋白诱导镜鲤肠道损伤。
text_zh: 大豆球蛋白和β-伴大豆球蛋白诱导镜鲤肠道损伤。
text_en: Soybean glycinin and beta-conglycinin induce intestinal damage in mirror carp.
intervention_record: 大豆球蛋白与β-伴大豆球蛋白

quote: Effects of methionine on growth performance, digestion and absorption, antioxidant capacity and gene expression of muscle synthesis pathway in Songpu mirror carp.
statement: 蛋氨酸对松浦镜鲤生长性能、消化吸收、抗氧化能力及肌肉合成通路基因表达的影响。
text_zh: 蛋氨酸对松浦镜鲤生长性能、消化吸收、抗氧化能力及肌肉合成通路基因表达的影响。
text_en: The effects of methionine on growth performance, digestion and absorption, antioxidant capacity, and gene expression of muscle synthesis pathways in Songpu mirror carp.

quote: Replacement of fishmeal with soybean meal affects the growth performance, digestive enzymes, intestinal microbiota and immunity of. Carassius auratus gibelio♀× Cyprinus carpio♂
statement: 用豆粕替代鱼粉影响异育银鲫（♀）×鲤鱼（♂）的生长性能、消化酶、肠道菌群和免疫力。
text_zh: 用豆粕替代鱼粉影响异育银鲫（♀）×鲤鱼（♂）的生长性能、消化酶、肠道菌群和免疫力。
text_en: Replacing fish meal with soybean meal affects the growth performance, digestive enzymes, gut microbiota, and immunity of gibel carp (♀) × common carp (♂).

quote: Dietary supplementation with fermented plant meal enhances growth, antioxidant capacity and expression of TOR signaling pathway genes in gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio var. CAS V).
statement: 日粮补充发酵植物粕增强异育银鲫（CAS V系）的生长、抗氧化能力以及TOR信号通路基因的表达。
text_zh: 日粮补充发酵植物粕增强异育银鲫（CAS V系）的生长、抗氧化能力以及TOR信号通路基因的表达。
text_en: Dietary supplementation with fermented plant meal enhanced the growth, antioxidant capacity, and expression of TOR signaling pathway genes in gibel carp (CAS V strain).

population.species: 异育银鲫 (Carassius auratus gibelio var. CAS V)

quote: Comparative study on the effects of L-methionine or 2-hydroxy-4-(methylthio) butanoic acid as dietary methionine source on growth performance and anti-oxidative responses of turbot (Psetta maxima).
statement: 比较L-蛋氨酸或2-羟基-4-(甲硫基)丁酸作为日粮蛋氨酸来源对大菱鲆生长性能和抗氧化反应的影响。
text_zh: 比较L-蛋氨酸或2-羟基-4-(甲硫基)丁酸作为日粮蛋氨酸来源对大菱鲆生长性能和抗氧化反应的影响。
text_en: Compare the effects of L-methionine or 2-hydroxy-4-(methylthio)butanoic acid as dietary methionine sources on growth performance and antioxidant response in turbot.

quote: The effect of dietary methionine on growth, antioxidant capacity, innate immune response and disease resistance of juvenile yellow catfish (Pelteobagrus fulvidraco).
statement: 日粮蛋氨酸对黄颡鱼幼鱼生长、抗氧化能力、先天免疫应答和抗病力的影响。
text_zh: 日粮蛋氨酸对黄颡鱼幼鱼生长、抗氧化能力、先天免疫应答和抗病力的影响。
text_en: Effects of dietary methionine on growth, antioxidant capacity, innate immune response, and disease resistance in juvenile yellow catfish.

quote: In a report on hybrid striped bass (Morone chrysops×M. siaxatilis), it was found that the shortage of Met in the diet may cause changes in the body’s antioxidant capacity, leading to oxidative stress (51).
statement: 在杂交条纹鲈中，日粮蛋氨酸缺乏可能导致机体抗氧化能力变化，进而引发氧化应激。
text_zh: 在杂交条纹鲈中，日粮蛋氨酸缺乏可能导致机体抗氧化能力变化，进而引发氧化应激。
text_en: In hybrid striped bass, dietary methionine deficiency may lead to changes in the body's antioxidant capacity, thereby triggering oxidative stress.

quote: Previous study reported that appropriate Met level could increase the antioxidant capacity and ameliorate oxidative damage in grouper (52).
statement: 先前的研究报道，适当的蛋氨酸水平可以增加石斑鱼的抗氧化能力并减轻氧化损伤。
text_zh: 先前的研究报道，适当的蛋氨酸水平可以增加石斑鱼的抗氧化能力并减轻氧化损伤。
text_en: Previous studies reported that appropriate methionine levels can increase the antioxidant capacity of grouper and reduce oxidative damage.
outcome: 抗氧化能力与氧化损伤

quote: In this study, gibel carp fed diets supplemented with coated Met showed lower MDA content and higher SOD activity compared to Met-deficient dietary treatments.
statement: 在本研究中，饲喂包被蛋氨酸饲料的银鲫与蛋氨酸缺乏组相比，表现出更低的MDA含量和更高的SOD活性。
text_zh: 在本研究中，饲喂包被蛋氨酸饲料的银鲫与蛋氨酸缺乏组相比，表现出更低的MDA含量和更高的SOD活性。
text_en: In this study, gibel carp fed encapsulated methionine feed showed lower MDA content and higher SOD activity compared to the methionine-deficient group.

quote: These results indicated that Met deficiency can cause an increase in MDA content in the liver of gibel carp, which may cause oxidative damage to the body (54).
statement: 这些结果表明，蛋氨酸缺乏会导致银鲫肝脏MDA含量增加，这可能引起机体氧化损伤。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，蛋氨酸缺乏会导致银鲫肝脏MDA含量增加，这可能引起机体氧化损伤。
text_en: These results indicate that methionine deficiency leads to an increase in liver MDA content in gibel carp, which may cause oxidative damage to the body.

quote: However, the addition of properly coated Met decreased the MDA content in the liver and increased the activity of SOD in the body, which was similar to the results of grouper (52) and hybrid striped bass (51).
statement: 然而，添加适当包被的蛋氨酸降低了肝脏中的MDA含量并增加了体内SOD的活性，这与石斑鱼和杂交条纹鲈的结果相似。
text_zh: 然而，添加适当包被的蛋氨酸降低了肝脏中的MDA含量并增加了体内SOD的活性，这与石斑鱼和杂交条纹鲈的结果相似。
text_en: However, adding appropriately encapsulated methionine reduced hepatic MDA content and increased in vivo SOD activity, which is similar to the results in grouper and hybrid striped bass.

quote:
During conditioning continuous water flow was provided through inlet for aeration to ensure
sufficient dissolved oxygen to the stocked brood fish in each cistern.
statement: 在驯化期间，通过入口提供连续水流进行曝气，以确保每个水箱中存养的亲鱼有充足的溶解氧。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，通过入口提供连续水流进行曝气，以确保每个水箱中存养的亲鱼有充足的溶解氧。
text_en: During acclimation, continuous water flow aeration was provided through the inlet to ensure sufficient dissolved oxygen for the broodstock held in each tank.

quote: The experimental results showed that AST in serum decreased with the addition of coated Met in the diet, but did not cause differences among dietary treatments, which was similar to the experimental results of golden pomfret (Trachinotus ovatus) (46).
statement: 实验结果显示，日粮中添加包被蛋氨酸后血清AST降低，但不同处理组间无显著差异，这与金鲳鱼的结果相似。
text_zh: 实验结果显示，日粮中添加包被蛋氨酸后血清AST降低，但不同处理组间无显著差异，这与金鲳鱼的结果相似。
text_en: The experimental results showed that serum AST decreased after adding encapsulated methionine to the diet, but there was no significant difference between different treatment groups, which is similar to the results for golden pompano.

population.species: 鲫鱼（gibel carp，根据上下文推断）

quote: Similarly, ALT showed a downward trend after the addition of coated Met.
statement: 同样，添加包被蛋氨酸后ALT呈下降趋势。
text_zh: 同样，添加包被蛋氨酸后ALT呈下降趋势。
text_en: Similarly, ALT showed a downward trend after the addition of encapsulated methionine.

population.species: 鲫鱼（gibel carp，根据上下文推断）

quote: AST and ALT activities were higher in the Met-deficient group, suggesting that the deficiency of Met in the diet may have disrupted the normal metabolism of the liver, leading to impaired liver function.
statement: 蛋氨酸缺乏组的AST和ALT活性较高，表明饮食中蛋氨酸缺乏可能扰乱了肝脏正常代谢，导致肝功能受损。
text_zh: 蛋氨酸缺乏组的AST和ALT活性较高，表明饮食中蛋氨酸缺乏可能扰乱了肝脏正常代谢，导致肝功能受损。
text_en: The activities of AST and ALT in the methionine-deficient group were higher, indicating that dietary methionine deficiency may disrupt normal liver metabolism, leading to impaired liver function.

population.species: 鲫鱼（gibel carp，根据上下文推断）

quote: The addition of coated Met could reduce serum ALT and AST activities, probably due to the interaction between Met and other amino acids, which maintains normal protein metabolism in the liver and is beneficial to liver health (47).
statement: 添加包被蛋氨酸可降低血清ALT和AST活性，这可能是由于蛋氨酸与其他氨基酸的相互作用维持了肝脏正常的蛋白质代谢，有利于肝脏健康。
text_zh: 添加包被蛋氨酸可降低血清ALT和AST活性，这可能是由于蛋氨酸与其他氨基酸的相互作用维持了肝脏正常的蛋白质代谢，有利于肝脏健康。
text_en: Adding encapsulated methionine can reduce serum ALT and AST activities, which may be due to the interaction of methionine with other amino acids maintaining normal liver protein metabolism, benefiting liver health.

population.species: 鲫鱼（gibel carp，根据上下文推断）

quote: During rearing period the fish were fed with commercial pelleted fish feed (25% protein) at the rate of 3% body weight (bw) once a day.
statement: 在培育期间，鱼类每天一次按体重的3%投喂商业颗粒饲料（蛋白质含量25%）。
text_zh: 在培育期间，鱼类每天一次按体重的3%投喂商业颗粒饲料（蛋白质含量25%）。
text_en: During the rearing period, fish were fed commercial pellet feed (25% protein) once daily at 3% of body weight.

quote: This solution was prepared by using 8.5 g NaCl in 1.0 L of water.
statement: 该溶液由1.0升水中加入8.5克氯化钠制备而成。
text_zh: 该溶液由1.0升水中加入8.5克氯化钠制备而成。
text_en: The solution was prepared by adding 8.5 grams of sodium chloride to 1.0 liter of water.

quote: During incubation period, dead embryos were removed to prevent fungal growth.
statement: 在孵化期间，移除死胚以防止真菌生长。
text_zh: 在孵化期间，移除死胚以防止真菌生长。
text_en: During incubation, remove dead embryos to prevent fungal growth.

quote: After completion of yolk sac absorption of the larvae, diluted boiled yolk of chicken eggs was provided as first food for the hatchlings at 6 h intervals and after 3-4 meals the spawn then was ready to release in the nursery ponds.
statement: 在仔鱼卵黄囊吸收完成后，以每6小时间隔提供稀释的煮鸡蛋黄作为初孵仔鱼的第一种食物，经过3-4餐喂食后，鱼苗即可准备放入育苗池。
text_zh: 在仔鱼卵黄囊吸收完成后，以每6小时间隔提供稀释的煮鸡蛋黄作为初孵仔鱼的第一种食物，经过3-4餐喂食后，鱼苗即可准备放入育苗池。
text_en: After the yolk sac of larvae is absorbed, diluted boiled egg yolk is provided as the first food for newly hatched larvae at intervals of every 6 hours; after 3-4 feedings, the fry are ready to be placed into nursery ponds.

quote: In addition, in aquaculture, they accept artificial feed such as by-products from grain processing and oil extraction and pelleted feed.
statement: 此外，在水产养殖中，它们接受人工饲料，如谷物加工和油提取的副产品以及颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 此外，在水产养殖中，它们接受人工饲料，如谷物加工和油提取的副产品以及颗粒饲料。
text_en: In addition, in aquaculture, they receive artificial feed, such as by-products of grain processing and oil extraction, and pellet feed.

quote: Energy metabolism related pathways such as oxoacid metabolic process and carboxylic acid metabolic process were obviously detected after 2 h duration stress.
statement: 在持续2小时的应激后，明显检测到与能量代谢相关的通路，如氧酸代谢过程和羧酸代谢过程。
text_zh: 在持续2小时的应激后，明显检测到与能量代谢相关的通路，如氧酸代谢过程和羧酸代谢过程。
text_en: After 2 hours of stress, pathways related to energy metabolism, such as oxoacid metabolic process and carboxylic acid metabolic process, were significantly detected.

quote: After ovulation, eight females and eight males from each treatment were selected for stripping.
statement: 排卵后，从每个处理组中选取八条雌鱼和八条雄鱼进行挤卵/挤精操作。
text_zh: 排卵后，从每个处理组中选取八条雌鱼和八条雄鱼进行挤卵/挤精操作。
text_en: After ovulation, eight females and eight males were selected from each treatment group for egg stripping/sperm stripping.

quote:
The female were checked every hour after 2 h of 2nd injection by gently pressing their abdomen to
ascertain the ovulation.
statement: 在第二次注射后2小时起，每小时通过轻轻按压腹部来检查雌鱼以确定是否排卵。
text_zh: 在第二次注射后2小时起，每小时通过轻轻按压腹部来检查雌鱼以确定是否排卵。
text_en: Starting 2 hours after the second injection, females are checked for ovulation every hour by gently pressing their abdomen.

quote:
Milt from the male fish was collected by applying
slight pressure on its abdomen.
statement: 通过对雄鱼腹部施加轻微压力来收集精液。
text_zh: 通过对雄鱼腹部施加轻微压力来收集精液。
text_en: Semen is collected by applying slight pressure to the abdomen of male fish.

quote: The selected brood fish were caught very carefully from the spawning tank and put on foam for injecting the PG extract to the recipient fish.
statement: 亲鱼从产卵池中被小心捕获并放置在泡沫上以准备注射。
text_zh: 亲鱼从产卵池中被小心捕获并放置在泡沫上以准备注射。
text_en: Broodstock are carefully captured from the spawning pool and placed on foam to prepare for injection.

quote: A piece of clean, soft and wet cloth was used to wrap up the fish and kept lying on foam.
statement: 使用干净、柔软且湿润的布包裹鱼类，并将其保持在泡沫上。
text_zh: 使用干净、柔软且湿润的布包裹鱼类，并将其保持在泡沫上。
text_en: Wrap fish in a clean, soft, and wet cloth and keep them on foam.

quote: During handling of the fish more care has taken and optimum water condition were maintained to minimize stress.
statement: 在处理鱼类过程中采取了更多预防措施，并维持最佳水质条件以尽量减少应激。
text_zh: 在处理鱼类过程中采取了更多预防措施，并维持最佳水质条件以尽量减少应激。
text_en: More preventive measures were taken during fish handling, and optimal water quality conditions were maintained to minimize stress.
intervention: Optimizing water quality to reduce stress

quote: Fish were anesthetized by immersion in a bath containing 10 mg/L benzocaine.
statement: 鱼通过浸泡在含有10毫克/升苯佐卡因的浴池中进行麻醉。
text_zh: 鱼通过浸泡在含有10毫克/升苯佐卡因的浴池中进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish are anesthetized by immersion in a bath containing 10 mg/L benzocaine.

quote: Fish were acclimatized at 20±2 ℃ in 45 L tanks with aerated fresh water for 15 days.
statement: 鱼在20±2℃、装有曝气淡水的45升水箱中适应环境15天。
text_zh: 鱼在20±2℃、装有曝气淡水的45升水箱中适应环境15天。
text_en: Fish were acclimated for 15 days in 45-liter tanks containing aerated freshwater at 20±2°C.

quote: Fish were fed with commercial dry feed distributed manually twice a day.
statement: 鱼每天两次人工投喂商业干饲料。
text_zh: 鱼每天两次人工投喂商业干饲料。
text_en: Fish are manually fed commercial dry feed twice a day.

quote: our study revealed that saline-alkaline stress could cause significant changes in renal function and metabolic profiles, and induce severe damage in the crucian carp kidney through destroying the anti-oxidant system and energy homeostasis, inhibiting protein and amino acid catabolism, as well as disordering purine metabolism and lipid metabolism.
statement: 盐碱胁迫会导致鲫鱼肾脏功能及代谢谱发生显著变化，并通过破坏抗氧化系统和能量稳态、抑制蛋白质和氨基酸分解代谢以及扰乱嘌呤和脂质代谢，对鲫鱼肾脏造成严重损伤。
text_zh: 盐碱胁迫会导致鲫鱼肾脏功能及代谢谱发生显著变化，并通过破坏抗氧化系统和能量稳态、抑制蛋白质和氨基酸分解代谢以及扰乱嘌呤和脂质代谢，对鲫鱼肾脏造成严重损伤。
text_en: Salt-alkali stress causes significant changes in kidney function and metabolic profiles of crucian carp, and severely damages the kidneys by disrupting the antioxidant system and energy homeostasis, inhibiting protein and amino acid catabolism, and disturbing purine and lipid metabolism.

quote: CA is considered a crucial stress factor as it affects the survival of aquatic animals in saline-alkali water
statement: 碳酸盐碱度（CA）被认为是影响盐碱水中水生动物存活的关键胁迫因子。
text_zh: 碳酸盐碱度（CA）被认为是影响盐碱水中水生动物存活的关键胁迫因子。
text_en: Carbonate alkalinity (CA) is considered a key stress factor affecting the survival of aquatic animals in saline-alkaline water.

quote: Proper care of brood stock is very important for assuring good production of eggs, fry and fingerlings (Robert et al., 1982).
statement: 亲鱼的妥善护理对于确保良好的卵、仔鱼和鱼种生产非常重要。
text_zh: 亲鱼的妥善护理对于确保良好的卵、仔鱼和鱼种生产非常重要。
text_en: Proper care of broodstock is very important for ensuring good production of eggs, larvae, and fingerlings.

quote: The daily and seasonal rates of feeding of brood stock diets have direct effects on fecundity and egg size (Jones and Bromage, 1987, Bromage and Cumaranatunga, 1988).
statement: 亲鱼饲料的每日和季节性投喂率对怀卵量和卵径有直接影响。
text_zh: 亲鱼饲料的每日和季节性投喂率对怀卵量和卵径有直接影响。
text_en: The daily and seasonal feeding rates of broodstock feed have a direct effect on egg production and egg diameter.

quote: In the present study brood stock management with balanced feed comprising adequate amount of protein, lipid, and carbohydrate, especially enriched with vitamin premix the fish C. carassius attained gonadal maturity in December-January and induced breeding was conducted successfully.
statement: 在本研究中，通过包含适量蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物且特别富含维生素预混料的平衡饲料进行亲鱼管理，使鲤鲫在12月至1月达到性腺成熟并成功进行了人工诱导繁殖。
text_zh: 在本研究中，通过包含适量蛋白质、脂质和碳水化合物且特别富含维生素预混料的平衡饲料进行亲鱼管理，使鲤鲫在12月至1月达到性腺成熟并成功进行了人工诱导繁殖。
